findings.title: Allowlist friction remains dominant after P0 docs
findings.summary: Independent JSONL parse of the 17 primary eligible sessions finds 143 allowlist-classified toolResult failures (≈85% of 169 isError). Lead census reports 142 failed-event total. Dominant residual patterns are shell pipelines and interpreter one-liners blocked by lean-ctx allowlist (python3/node -e, pipes into interpreters, command-substitution shapes), plus repeated ctx_shell retries after first block. P0 documented policy/strategy; runtime allowlist and agent behavior still produce the same failure class.
evidence: independent parse primary_dir_overlap: allowN=143, errN=169, toolResults=1778, topErrTools ctx_shell=143

allowlist sample texts: "Command blocked by shell allowlist: python3 /tmp/analyze_sessions.py | …"; "Command blocked by shell allowlist: cat … | python3 -c …"; node -e blocked as permanent restriction
packet candidates E1–E5 still carry executionFailures 5/11/7/5/8 on 19/17/26/1/2 toolCalls
post-P0 slice too short (~8m) to measure fix efficacy; S1-class session lastTs 2026-08-05T07:04:07Z with 41 failures / 34 allowlist (session totals, not pure post-P0)
findings.uncertainty: Exact post-P0-only allowlist delta not separable without time-sliced failure stamps on the open long session; treat residual as pre-P0 stock plus unverified post-P0.

findings.title: Native edit misses remain material; packet under-reports edits
findings.summary: Independent parse: 119 edit toolCalls, 11 edit-miss toolResults ("Could not found the exact text" / exact-text mismatch class) ≈9.2% of edits. Lead evidence claims "No edit event was observed" — false negative vs raw JSONL. Identical oldText retry count observed at least once in parse heuristics. Residual improvement: edit strategy (re-read slice, sed/perl fallback, no identical retry) is still not consistently followed under friction.
evidence: edit miss sample: "Could not find the exact text in /home/alex/.pi/agent/…"
lead-evidence.md: "No edit event was observed in the analyzed sample" — conflicts with JSONL
identicalEditRetry heuristic >0 on primary tools set
findings.uncertainty: medium — miss classifier is string-based; some edit isError may be non-miss.

findings.title: Long-session outcome review still fully open
findings.summary: 7/17 (41.2%) sessions exceed active-long threshold (longest 498m). reviewedActiveLongCount=0; outcomeReview.status=required; recommendation controlled-a-b-required. Lead samples S1–S4 carry 41/9/13/13 failure events. Independent parse confirms 7 long sessions and 0 with mid-flight/end-checklist outcome language. This is an investigation lead, not a confirmed decomposition/model defect — but it blocks efficiency claims and is unchanged by allowlist P0.
evidence: reviewLead id session-usage-outcome-review-gap present in lead-summary

findings.summary: Beyond allowlist, independent parse attributes isError to ctx_find (8) and ctx_edit (5). Samples show lean-ctx find glob failures and "MCP error -32602: Tool ctx_edit not connected". These are separate residual reliability tracks from P0 allowlist docs.

read_miss=42 secondary path-friction (ENOENT/not-found class) on read/ctx_read paths

findings.title: Friction has no structured consequence/completion linkage
findings.summary: Packet populationCoverage.withFrictionConsequence=0, withStructuredCompletion=0, withChanges=0 despite withExecutionFriction=21 and heavy tool activity. Failures are counted but not tied to task outcome, repair, or change sets — so residual improvements cannot be ranked by user-visible impact from packet alone.

narrative: Pass B session-evidence on remaining improvements after allowlist P0 (docs at 06:56Z). Eligible set is complete (17/17). Residual stack is clear: (1) allowlist/shell still ≈85% of failures — docs did not clear behavioral residual; (2) edit-miss ~9% of edit calls, invisible to lead/packet; (3) 7 long sessions still unreviewed for outcome; (4) ctx_find/ctx_edit bridge errors; (5) zero friction-consequence linkage so impact ranking is blocked. Post-P0 window is only ~8 minutes — no fix validation. Highest leverage next: runtime allowlist/strategy-switch, bounded S1–S7 outcome review, and insights adapter repair for edits+consequences.
